name: Zaiqa Restaurant (JKTDC Hotel Alpine)
why_it_matters: JKTDC's Hotel Alpine cafeteria sits a couple of minutes' walk from the Mughal Garden — the in-house cook (long-serving Mohammad Sayeed in recent reports) prepares home-style Kashmiri dishes after you order, which means a 30-40 min wait but real cooking. The monje haaq (Kashmiri spinach with knol-khol) is the dish locals point to.
insider_tip: Tell the cook you're a day-tripper and have a return drive — he'll prioritise simpler dishes (egg curry, dal, haakh) that finish in 20 minutes. Full-on rogan josh needs an hour's heads-up.
signature_address: JKTDC Hotel Alpine, Near Mughal Garden, Achabal, Anantnag District 192201

name: Hangul The Lounge and Cafe
why_it_matters: One of the few proper sit-down cafes between Anantnag town and Achabal Garden — multi-cuisine menu spanning pizza, Chinese and Kashmiri wazwan in a lounge-style room. Useful for kids or travellers who've had three rogan-josh meals in a row.
insider_tip: Stick to the Indian and pizza side of the menu; the 'continental' items are competent but the kitchen's strength is the tandoor and the wazwan station. Open 11:30 AM to 10 PM.
signature_address: Achabal-Gopalpur Road, Anantnag East, Anantnag District 192125
